About this documentation

Every page carries its audience, Diátaxis type, version, last-verified date, source artefact, and a Markdown mirror (linked in the meta block). Status, lifecycle, and pricing facts are generated from the same canonical sources as the status page and are covered by CI drift checks. The Maintainers pack is the one deliberate boundary: structure public, internals on request.

Documentation error? It is a product error — report it on GitHub Issues, user-initiated only.
